enchantments.tooltip: Reflex Save +7: This item gives a +7 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Deception +5: +5 Enhancement bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Assassinate +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
